subject: acceptance-project-permissions
title: Acceptance project permission gate
request: Confirm that project admins, reviewers, viewers, and automation tokens receive only their expected acceptance permissions.
change: Deploys the Nib public Worker and service-binding dependencies into an isolated preview stack with seeded team, project, reviewer, viewer, and automation-token fixtures.

criteria.text: A project admin can manage members and publish acceptance manifests.
criteria.verification: Run the permissions smoke with the seeded admin account.

criteria.text: A viewer can read the review but cannot publish, vote, invalidate, or manage credentials.
criteria.verification: Run the permissions smoke with the seeded viewer account.

criteria.text: A project automation credential can publish and verify only for the seeded project scopes.
criteria.verification: Run the permissions smoke with the seeded automation token.
